stage_declaration.primary_study: Full-S1 vs K1, protocol lightweight_pcste_final_test_v1, pre-registered and sealed, COMPLETED AND FROZEN BEFORE this extension was created.
stage_declaration.primary_efficiency_benchmark: lightweight_pcste_efficiency_v1, COMPLETED AND FROZEN BEFORE this extension.
stage_declaration.note: Q8 must never be presented as part of the original sealed Full-S1-vs-K1 comparison. The primary confirmatory claim and its -0.02 margin are unaffected by anything in this extension.

chain: Full-S1 -> K1 FP32 -> Q8(K1); Q8 is derived deterministically from each frozen K1 checkpoint, not trained.

quantization.weights: per-output-channel symmetric int8, zero-point 0, scale = max|w_row| / 127, axis = output channel (dim 0)
quantization.scope: nn.Linear modules matching the frozen allowlist only
stays_fp32: stem.conv (Conv2d: not an nn.Linear, so outside the allowlist by construction)
recurrent state / exp(delta*A) selective-scan path (not a parameterised module)
quantization.calibration_rationale: The registered recipe is weight-only for the accuracy representation, and the CPU deployment representation uses DYNAMIC activation quantization whose scales are computed at runtime. No calibration dataset is required or used. The static W8A8 variant that would need TRAIN calibration is an exploratory VAL-only scaffold and is NOT part of this extension.

representations.sim: int8 weight-only, dequantised to fp32 for compute; identical numerics on CPU and GPU; THE ACCURACY REPRESENTATION (frozen designation in quantization_spec.yaml)
representations.cpu_dynamic: torch.ao dynamic quantization, per-channel int8 weights + dynamic int8 activations, allowlisted modules only; THE CPU DEPLOYMENT REPRESENTATION

quantization.numerics_gap_disclosure: cpu_dynamic additionally quantizes activations, so its numerics differ from sim. TEST accuracy is evaluated for sim only, per the frozen designation. The sim-vs-cpu_dynamic prediction agreement is quantified on VALIDATION only, never on TEST, to bound the deployment gap without a second TEST touch.

test_membership.rule: split == 'test' rows of the frozen fold manifest, exactly as the primary study used; membership is re-asserted per cell

evaluation.macro_4: (CWRU + JNU + HIT + MaFaulDa) / 4, equal domain weights, no window weighting
evaluation.metric_module: src/pcste_v2/metrics_v2.evaluate_split + the primary driver's add_macro_fields aggregation
evaluation.k1_reference: the ALREADY-FROZEN K1 TEST results; K1 inference is NOT rerun
evaluation.delta: Q8 - K1, paired within the same (fold, seed) cell
evaluation.device: cuda (matches the primary driver's --device auto resolution on this host); the sim representation is fp32 compute so CPU and GPU numerics agree

provenance.value: one-sided exact sign-flip on MARGIN-SHIFTED deltas (delta + m); H0: mean(delta) <= -m; exact, all 512 patterns

statistics.call: src.methodology_v2.compression.stats.contrast('H3 Q8(K1) vs K1', q8, k1, 'ni', 0.01) — the exact historical call signature used by stats.confirmatory_family
statistics.superiority_rationale: kind='ni' in the historical family runs non-inferiority only; no superiority test is defined for Q8 and none is added.
statistics.holm_family: NOT APPLIED. The historical Holm m=3 family (H1 K1 vs S1, H2 K1 vs C_small, H3 Q8 vs K1) is not executable: C_small was never evaluated, and the primary study already established its single confirmatory contrast without that family. H3 is therefore run STANDALONE as a secondary contrast and carries no family-wise error control from the historical family. This is disclosed rather than reconstructed.
statistics.margin_separation: The primary Full-S1-vs-K1 architecture margin of -0.02 does NOT apply to Q8. The PTQ margin is -0.01.

representative_cell.rule: the same deterministic cell used by lightweight_pcste_efficiency_v1 (lowest fold, then lowest seed)

measurements: Q8 compact int8 state bytes (int8 tensors + fp32 per-channel scales + untouched fp32 tensors)
torch.ao cpu_dynamic packed state bytes (reported SEPARATELY: includes runtime packing overhead)
size.method: actual torch.save bytes, never an estimate (frozen rule in quantization_spec.yaml)
size.separation_rule: packed-runtime bytes and theoretical int8 weight bytes are never mixed into one number

latency.inputs: the same deterministic VALIDATION windows as efficiency_v1 (never TEST)

cpu.backend: torch.ao dynamic, engine selected by the historical cpu_dynamic_quantize (fbgemm if available)

latency.aggregation: equal-domain mean of per-dataset medians, matching efficiency_v1
latency.gpu: Determined empirically before timing. The registered Q8 provides NO true INT8 CUDA kernel: 'sim' dequantises to fp32 and torch.ao dynamic quantization is a CPU backend. Any GPU number is therefore SIMULATED Q8 and must not be presented as INT8 GPU acceleration.
latency.historical_latency_claim: quantization_spec.yaml states: latency_claim = 'NONE for Q8 (weight-only int8 does not speed the reference scan)'. Measured CPU latency is reported as a deployment observation, not as a retro-fit to that historical statement.

prohibitions_observed: no retraining of Full-S1 or K1
no rerun of K1 inference to reproduce existing metrics
no change to existing Full-S1-vs-K1 statistical claims
no modification of historical frozen TEST artifacts
no reuse of dissertation-era Q8 results
no modification of the dissertation repository
no edit of the historical quantization implementation
